errors.STOCK_MOVEMENT_COST_REQUIRED: Stock coming in needs a cost. Enter the cost or choose where it comes from.
errors.COST_ZERO_REASON_REQUIRED: A zero cost needs a reason
errors.COST_UNDETERMINED: The cost of this stock cannot be determined, so the posting is blocked
errors.COST_NEGATIVE_STOCK_NOT_SUPPORTED: This item does not have enough stock. Negative stock is not allowed for costed items
errors.COST_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency does not match the organization currency
errors.COST_REVERSAL_BLOCKED_STOCK_USED: This cannot be undone because some of the stock was already used. Use a return or an adjustment instead
errors.COST_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The source transaction for this cost was not found
errors.COST_SOURCE_EXCEEDED: The quantity is more than the source transaction allows
errors.COST_METHOD_NOT_READY: This item must be converted to its costing method before it can be used
errors.COST_METHOD_LOCKED: The costing method cannot be changed while the item has stock or cost records
errors.COST_CONVERSION_DRIFT: Stock quantities and cost records do not match for this item. Fix the difference before converting
errors.COST_POOL_INCONSISTENT: The cost records of this item are inconsistent. The posting was stopped
